about: RUNS A LANDED CAR'S RECORDED PROBE — as david, never root — and writes the verdict on the car: `boss prove <car> --from-car --unattended`, the tree's CLI installed on this host from the converged image (infra/estate/install-cli-from-image.sh; backlog 9f00a805 car 1). Until car 2 of the same item (2026-09-18) this verb ran infra/forge/run-car-probe.sh, 482 lines of shell re-implementing `boss prove`'s judge, verdict and records because the forge had no boss binary; the twin and its pin are deleted and the one definition is crates/orchestrators/boss-cli/src/prove.rs. The dispatcher rule run-car-probes-on-train-arrived files one of these per car aboard an arrived train that recorded `proof_probe`/`proof_expect` at park time (`boss gate --park-probe/--park-expect`); recheck-failing-probes-daily files one per car whose last run settled nothing. The verb re-reads the car from the system of record and refuses (exit 2, nothing run) unless it is a ship-a-change car with metadata.merged=true, a recorded probe AND expect, and an open `proven` step; a car already proven is nothing to run, exit 0. It runs the probe with `runuser -u david` (BOSS_PROBE_USER), cwd the converged checkout /home/david/boss (BOSS_PROBE_DIR), under a 60 s timeout (BOSS_PROBE_TIMEOUT), with exactly the environment a recorded probe is promised — BOSS_JOBS_URL, the READ-ONLY reader identity as BOSS_SOR_USER (audit-readonly, 61085a9e), its port table as BOSS_SOR_PORTS (design 28d2bed9) and infra/forge/probe-bin first on PATH — and never this verb's own write actor; judges by the two rules `boss prove` applies (exit 0 and the expected string printed, a number as a whole token); completes `proven` with `boss prove`'s proof record and proven_by on green, or stamps `proof_attempt` on the car, leaves `proven` ready and exits so this packet's exit_code carries the verdict: 1 not proven, 3 did not run (fd 9 caught a tool this host lacks — f9304366), 75 not yet. The output leads with PROVEN / NOT YET / NOT RUN / NOT PROVEN and the car. BOSS_ACTOR is the runner's own account, handed over by ops-runner.sh; BOSS_JOBS_URL is /etc/boss/sor.env through the runner's unit. Nothing on this host is mutated by the verb itself. The bound, honestly: the probe is program text the car's builder wrote — the same builder whose branch just merged and was converged onto the cluster by this host as this same user — and what may run is exactly one recorded command, for a merged car only, as david. The verb's own argument is a full uuid, pattern-checked here. Authorization: the routed build on backlog 28ac45ab (2026-09-08), the same per-verb process as reclaim-disk / converge / publish-github-pr — flagged for David's review as the first verb that runs builder-authored text.
